property_summary: After buyShares, if correctRState is called and the RState is BELOW_ONE, the contract resets to ONE if and only if the base reserve is strictly less than the base target; the mutant incorrectly resets even when base reserve is greater than or equal to the base target.

After buyShares when RState is BELOW_ONE, the base target and quote target are only reset to current reserves if the base reserve is strictly less than the base target; otherwise they remain unchanged.
After buyShares, if RState becomes BELOW_ONE, the invariant _BASE_TARGET_ <= _BASE_RESERVE_ holds in the original, but can be violated in the mutant.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the contract's _BASE_TARGET_ should never exceed _BASE_RESERVE_ when the state is BELOW_ONE, but the mutant incorrectly resets the state and sets _BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_ when _BASE_RESERVE_ >= _BASE_TARGET_, which can increase _BASE_TARGET_ above the original value.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_TARGET_ should never increase, but the bug can increase it by incorrectly resetting state when _BASE_RESERVE_ >= _BASE_TARGET_.

After a call to adjustMtFeeRate that does not revert, _BASE_TARGET_ must remain less than or equal to the current _BASE_RESERVE_ when the state is BELOW_ONE, but the mutant can cause _BASE_TARGET_ to incorrectly become equal to _BASE_RESERVE_ via the flipped condition.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, if _RState_ is BELOW_ONE, then _BASE_TARGET_ must be strictly less than _BASE_RESERVE_; the mutant incorrectly resets the state and sets _BASE_TARGET_ equal to _BASE_RESERVE_ when _BASE_RESERVE_ >= _BASE_TARGET_.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, if the contract's RState was BELOW_ONE before the call, the invariant that _BASE_TARGET_ < _BASE_RESERVE_ must hold; the mutant breaks this by resetting the state and setting _BASE_TARGET_ equal to _BASE_RESERVE_ when the reserve is not actually below target.
correctRState only resets from ABOVE_ONE to ONE when the quote reserve is strictly below the quote target; the mutant incorrectly resets when it is greater or equal.
After buyShares, if _RState_ is ABOVE_ONE, _QUOTE_TARGET_ must be strictly greater than _QUOTE_RESERVE_ (otherwise correctRState would have reset to ONE).
After buyShares, if the PMM state is ABOVE_ONE and a reset condition is met, the target reserves must equal the current reserves
When RState is ABOVE_ONE, correctRState resets to ONE only when quote reserve is strictly below quote target, so after buyShares the quote target is never less than or equal to quote reserve.

property_summary: After buyShares, if the PMM state is ABOVE_ONE, the quote target must be strictly greater than the quote reserve; otherwise correctRState would have reset to ONE.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_TARGET_ should never be changed by correctRState when the reserve is not genuinely below its target, because correctRState only resets when QUOTE_RESERVE_ < QUOTE_TARGET_ for an ABOVE_ONE state; the mutant resets also when QUOTE_RESERVE_ >= QUOTE_TARGET_, causing an unintended _BASE_TARGET_ update.

After a successful call to adjustMtFeeRate, correctRState should only reset _BASE_TARGET_ when the system is ABOVE_ONE and the actual quote reserve is strictly below its target; the mutant violates this by resetting when the quote reserve is above or equal, causing an unintended _BASE_TARGET_ change detectable via the public getter _BASE_TARGET_.
